description: Runs simulations across a list of values for one parameter, returning control quality metrics (IAE, overshoot, settling_time, steady_state_error) per value. Requires measureBlockId and setpoint.

blockId.description: ID of the block to tune

measureBlockId.description: Scope or Display block ID to read the controlled signal from

setpoint.description: Expected final value for error calculation (default: 1)
